evidence_required: FT-003-AC-008 / REQ-005 / REQ-006 / REQ-014 RED: a rendered calendar lesson lacks a link to the existing `/lesson-context` route, loses any of the exact date/class/lesson query values, or adds `studentAccountId`; GREEN: a fresh real route/SSR probe follows a DB-backed calendar lesson link, proves the query key set is exactly `date`, `classId`, `lessonId`, observes the existing shared Lesson Context response identity, and proves read-path state equality; artifact: `.tasks/TASK-039-T3-FT-003-W10/` and `.protocols/TASK-039-T3-FT-003-W10/verification.md`.
purpose: Make each authorized calendar lesson navigate to the existing shared Lesson Context route with the exact accepted query identity.
success_outcome: A lesson rendered by the authorized calendar exposes a link to `/lesson-context` carrying exactly `date`, `classId`, and `lessonId`; it carries no `studentAccountId`, and the existing route remains responsible for shared composition and server-side authorization.
anti_goals: Do not replace the public home fixture or change the `/calendar` server load and DB-backed lesson ownership established by TASK-037.

Do not modify the existing `/lesson-context` route/module, add a second day-context API, or implement personal student context; that context is deferred to a separate role-scoped follow-up after dashboard work.
Do not trust client-selected role, center, class, lesson, or student fields and do not write scheduling, lesson, progress, collaboration, or financial state.

stop_conditions: Stop if preserving shared navigation requires changing the existing Lesson Context route/module, adding a new API or persistence boundary, or bypassing its server-side authorization; route to /spec-redesign only for an accepted shared-boundary change.
Stop if the rendered calendar link cannot carry exactly date, classId, and lessonId without adding studentAccountId or another student contract.
Stop if the calendar link cannot be proved independently from TASK-037's protected-load matrix; do not inherit its proof as AC-008 evidence.

constraints: The component consumes only the server-rendered lesson identity and authorized class scope from TASK-037; it does not resolve authorization or read persistence itself.
Calendar lesson links target the existing `/lesson-context` query shape with exactly `date`, `classId`, and `lessonId`; the link MUST NOT include `studentAccountId`.

The navigation probe must follow a real rendered link and independently compare exact query identity, existing shared response identity, and read-path state equality; TASK-037's DB calendar proof is a dependency, not inherited AC-008 evidence.
invariants: Calendar-to-Lesson-Context navigation preserves exact date/class/lesson identity and no studentAccountId is present in the calendar link.
The existing Lesson Context route remains the composition and server-side authorization owner; this task introduces no personal student contract, persistence, or cross-slice write.
The public `/` fixture, TASK-037 protected-load boundary, existing Lesson Context owner, downstream feature ownership, and all completed prerequisite tasks remain unchanged.
verification_targets: FT-003-AC-008 / REQ-005 / REQ-006 / REQ-014: follow one real rendered lesson link, assert the exact `/lesson-context` path and query key set `{date, classId, lessonId}`, assert no `studentAccountId`, observe existing shared DayContext identity, and compare state before/after the read.

Boundary regression: source review confirms only the calendar presentation/link surface and its isolated navigation test changed, the link targets the existing `/lesson-context` path, no client role/student trust or direct persistence exists, and project-native check/test/build/diff gates pass.
